messages:
maria: Heads-up — want to align on the OSS local refapp demo + quickstart webinar plan. goal: get 3 small tutorials, one reference app walkthrough, and a short benchmark narrative to seed the blog + webinar. timeline: 3 weeks. Who can take which piece? :spiral_calendar:
aj: I can own the webinar logistics + signup funnel. thinking Wed 3/11 or Thu 3/12 (late afternoon PT). Do we want a live demo + Q&A or pre-record + live Q&A? Also need a headline metric for the benchmark (latency/cost per 1k tokens).
maria: Live demo + live Q&A wins for community engagement. keep pre-recorded fallback. benchmark metric = p99 latency + avg tokens/sec; simple chart. aj — can you draft the funnel (CTAs, UTM, form fields)?
aj: Yep. draft funnel: landing page -> signup form -> calendar invite + follow-up email -> reminder 1h before. sample UTM: ?utm_campaign=oss-quickstart&utm_source=community&utm_medium=web

kevin: I'll take the reference app walkthrough and the repo PRs. plan to add a "getting started" script and a tiny dataset. question: where should leads be routed? marketing CRM or a shared channel? we want to tag companies that exceed usage threshold.
maria: Route to CRM (Marketo) with source=webinar, and post a summary to #sales-inbound. tag by company domain + estimated tokens/week. kevin — add an optional field on signup: company size (drop-down) so we can triage.
jess: I'll draft the launch blog + social copy. two messaging options: 1) "Ship production inference faster" (product/ops angle) 2) "Build with open models locally" (dev/community angle). recommend testing both via email subject lines and 2 social variations. also need 3 short code snippets for the post.
maria: Good. A/B subject lines — send to 10% segments. jess, can you prep both subject lines by EOW?
jess: Yes. will share drafts in this thread. also: can we get a short quote from eng (latency improvement stat) to include? @kevin can you pull a number from your refapp run?
kevin: ran quick local benchmark: baseline 700ms p95 for 256 tokens on CPU -> optimized config with batching: 120ms p95 on a single GPU. will post numbers + simple command used.```bash
python benchmarks/run.py --model gpt-small --batch 8 --seq 256
```
sam: I'll own the webinar platform (StreamYard) and recordings. need a speaker list + 10-min demo script. also volunteer for moderating Q&A.
maria: Speaker list: kevin (refapp), aj (platform + routing), jess (marketing), sam (moderator). keep demo to 12 minutes. draft timeline: intro 5m, demo 12m, benchmarks 5m, roadmap 5m, Q&A 20m.

deploy-bot: note: scheduled deploy window for the quickstart repo is 1793450000-1793453600 UTC. avoid merging large infra changes during that window.
maria: thanks — we'll avoid merges then. next steps: aj to post funnel wireframe by Tue, kevin to open refapp PR by Thu, jess to share copy by Fri, sam to confirm StreamYard slot. I'll consolidate and send calendar invites. :rocket:
